title: Misplaced doc comment: load_tls_acceptor_with_key_bytes inherits load_tls_acceptor docs
description: crates/reader/src/tls.rs lines 130-131: new function was inserted after the last two lines of load_tls_acceptor doc comment. Those lines ('PEM loading is handled by stoa-tls; the NNTP-specific PermissiveClientAuth verifier is assembled here.') now belong to load_tls_acceptor_with_key_bytes instead of load_tls_acceptor. load_tls_acceptor at line 159 has no doc comment at all. cargo doc will show wrong docs for both functions.
